About the Hackathon

Hackathon 2.0 – 2026 is a 30-hour, fully offline innovation and technology challenge designed to bring together students, developers, innovators, designers, researchers, and aspiring entrepreneurs to develop practical and technology-driven solutions to real-world problems.

Event Details

Particular Details
Event Hackathon 2.0 – 2026
Mode Fully Offline
Duration 30 Hours
Date 7–8 October 2026
Venue Shivalik University, Dehradun
Team Size Minimum 4 and Maximum 6 Members
Registration Fee Inr 250 per Member
Prize Pool Up to Inr 2,00,000
Startup Incubation Support Up to Inr 15,00,000
Judging Process Three Rounds
Number of Themes Seven
Accommodation Dormitory Accommodation from 6 October to 9 October 2026 Morning
Fooding All Meals from 6 October Night to 9 October 2026 Morning
Official Website Https://shivatech2026.Vercel.App/

Team Structure

Each Participating Team Must Consist Of:

Minimum: 4 Members
Maximum: 6 Members

The Following Conditions Apply:

  • Every Team Must Have at Least Four Members.
  • A Team Cannot Have More than Six Members.
  • Each Team Member Must Complete the Required Registration Process.
  • The Registration Fee Is Inr 250 per Member.
  • Each Participant Can Be Associated with Only One Registered Team.
  • Teams May Consist of Participants from Different Departments, Disciplines, or Institutions, Subject to The Applicable Event Guidelines.
  • Multidisciplinary Teams Are Encouraged.

  • Prize money inculde tax liability(Tax will be deducted as per new tax poilicy of government ...respective of TDS amount)

The Recommended Team Structure May Include Members with Expertise in Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Design, Domain Knowledge, Business Development, Research, and Presentation.

Registration Fee

The Registration Fee Is:

INR 250 per Member

Accordingly:

Team Size Total Registration Fee
4 Members Inr 1,000
6 Members Inr 1,500

Each Participating Member Must Complete the Applicable Registration and Payment Process.

Accommodation

Dormitory-style accommodation will be available for Registered Participants.

Accommodation Period

6 October 2026 to 9 October 2026 Morning

Check-In: 6 October 2026

Check-Out: 9 October 2026 Morning

The Accommodation Arrangement Is Intended to Support Participants Travelling from Outside Dehradun and Enable Them to Attend the Complete Hackathon.

Themes 

  • Infrastructure
  • Clean and Green Technology
  • Smart Agriculutre
  • Travel and Tourism
  • Smart Healthcare
  • Ai or Cyber Security
  • Open Theme
